description: Production-oriented ASP.NET Core project and item templates built with Wolverine CQRS, Vertical Slice Architecture (VSA), EF Core, FluentValidation, and Mapster.
releaseNotes: v2.1.0 ships a single .slnx solution, an opt-in Docker / Docker Compose setup that adapts to the selected database, an Aspire Dashboard service wired to OpenTelemetry over OTLP, and central package pinning limited to the selected options.
title: Net Vertical Slice Templates
